# unite-pin (lid + pin)
# valid 1, counts 1/1/10/18/12, faces unnamed 0, faces with >1 name 0
# edges 18, seam edges 2, degenerate 0, face pairs shared by >1 edge: 0 (0 edges)

  xmax                 unchanged -> F6=xmax

  zmin                 modified into 1, generated 2 -> F5=zmin
  zmax                 modified into 1, generated 2 -> F3=zmax
  pin:side             modified into 2, generated 2 (Modified order != geometric order) -> F8=pin:side#1 F7=pin:side#2
  pin:top              unchanged -> F9=pin:top
  pin:bottom           unchanged -> F10=pin:bottom
